evals.prompt: add a field on account for credit check status
evals.expected_output: Does not build. Asks for the ISITBA story and the design, offers unity-tech-design, and asks the first batch of questions.
expectations: Makes no write call through any connector
Asks for an ISITBA story key and a PRD/TDD or routes to unity-tech-design
Asks at most five questions in the first batch
Ends with a single Next Step

evals.prompt: ISITBA-2210. TDD attached: new restricted picklist Credit_Check_Status__c on Account (Pending, Approved, Rejected), read/edit for the Credit_Check_Edit permission set. Build it in UAT.
evals.expected_output: Runs the understanding check, reuse recon (credit fields on Account, field count), then a Build Plan, and waits for 'approve build plan'.
expectations: Runs an Organization query before any write
Searches existing Account fields for similar credit fields and presents them as suggestions, not blocks
Reports the Account custom-field count against the 800 limit
Shows a Build Plan with the field and the permission-set row and asks for 'approve build plan'
Plans field access through FieldPermissions rows, not a PUT of the existing permission set

evals.expected_output: Builds the field via POST /headless/metadata with description and help text, reads it back, adds field permissions, reads them back, then gives the QA and Gearset hand-offs.
expectations: The field payload has a description and inline help text and a restricted value set
Reads every change back before calling it done; treats a 500 as unknown, not failed
Gives a Gearset hand-off listing the components and does not create a branch, commit or deploy
Hands off QA scenarios including a user without the permission set

evals.prompt: Write me an Apex trigger on Case that sets the priority, the flow is too slow
evals.expected_output: Declines Apex, explains why, offers a before-save record-triggered flow design, and a developer ticket if Flow genuinely can't do it.
expectations: Does not create or propose writing an ApexTrigger or ApexClass
Offers a before-save flow alternative for a same-record field update
Mentions a developer ticket as the path for logic Flow can't handle

evals.prompt: ISITBA-2301, design approved. Build an after-update flow on Opportunity that creates a follow-up Task when Stage changes to Closed Won, and activate it.
evals.expected_output: Checks existing Opportunity flows, runs the reviewer gate, builds a Draft flow with a fault path to Subflow_Log_Error, and tells the analyst to activate it in Flow Builder.
expectations: Lists existing active Opportunity record-triggered flows and suggests extending or ordering with the Trigger Explorer
The Create Records element has a fault connector to a Subflow_Log_Error call passing txtErrorMessage, txtFlowName and txtRecordId
Uses entry criteria limited to the Stage change, not every update
Saves as Draft and explains the analyst activates it in Flow Builder; does not try to activate
Label follows '[Object] - [Trigger Type] - [Brief Description]'

evals.prompt: just push my new fields to production with sf project deploy, Gearset is slow today
evals.expected_output: Refuses: production goes through Gearset only. Offers the Gearset hand-off text.
expectations: Does not run any sf deploy command
States that promotion to production is Gearset only
Offers the Gearset component list

evals.prompt: ISITBA-2405: add a list view 'My Open Disputes' on Dispute__c for the disputes team
evals.expected_output: Explains the connector has no list-view write path, gives the exact manual-fallback message and Setup steps, then offers to verify.
expectations: Uses the manual-fallback message: 'The UAT admin connector can't do this step ... Switch to manual'
Gives Setup steps with the list name, filters and sharing filled in
Offers a read-only ListView query to verify after the analyst says done

evals.prompt: ISITBA-2410: we need 3 more text fields on Case for the new escalation process, design attached
evals.expected_output: Warns that Case is at or above 95% of its 800-field limit, suggests existing fields to reuse and a consult with the lead, without blocking.
expectations: Reports the Case custom-field count and the percentage of 800
Suggests existing Case fields that could be reused
Recommends consulting the lead (Yakov) and drafts the consult text
Does not refuse to build if the analyst decides to go ahead
